notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content: We've added new casual and normal difficulty options, holiday character skins, artifacts that enable new powerful abilities, and a new Holiday themed campaign. The new campaign features Santa, Mrs. Claus, Elfs, and Krampus!  There are 9 character skins and 15 artifacts to find in the campaign.

notes.title: Holiday Content Update Coming Soon
notes.content: We're busy working on the December content update. We'll be introducing casual and normal difficulty options, holiday character skins, artifacts that enable new powerful abilities, and a new Holiday themed campaign. The new campaign will feature Santa, Mrs. Claus, and Krumpus! In addition there will be a new elf minion. Stay tuned for the new release in the coming weeks.
